MoveAssets.note: pure editor AssetTools rename; no Carla C++ involved

PrepareAssetsForCooking.note: Carla commandlet binary (spawns meshes, sets Carla materials by SSTags, SaveWorld, OpenDriveActor BuildRoutes/AddSpawners); behavior is plugin-code

LoadAssetMaterials.note: Carla commandlet assigning materials incl. tagged registries

BuildBinaryForTM.note_libcarla: uses INSTALLED carla python package, not the rebuilt libs directly

ordering_question: UE4Editor-CarlaUE4.dll (2026-10-03) predates LibCarla rebuilds (2026-10-05) and plugin source edits (GameMode, GNSS, V2X, Map/GeoReference). PrepareAssetsForCooking + LoadAssetMaterials execute Carla plugin code whose sources changed since the DLL was built.
decision_rule_applied: Missing postprocess commandlets depend on UE plugin code whose behavior could change when rebuilt; keep ImportAssets and postprocessing on the coherent (current-DLL) binary generation. Relink only after salvage receipts exist, then re-validate georeference behavior (sources include GeoReferenceParser/MapBuilder changes).
